result.title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
result.summary: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D, a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page.

AI.brief_summary: Holo4D 提出用前馈 4D 重建得到的 3D 轨迹投影到目标视角，作为几何脚手架条件去引导预训练视频扩散模型，实现单目视频的新相机轨迹重拍与新视角生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于视频扩散与 4D 重建的相机控制，未涉及 latent 推理状态、证据筛选、停止决策或 VLM 推理，与 LVR 主线缺乏实质联系，也没有可核查的具体借鉴线索。
